evaluation.hallucination_trigger: This is a book cover with NO text — leather binding with decorative border tooling and a measuring ruler on the left edge. There is zero text to transcribe. Any OCR output beyond a blank/cover marker is hallucinated.
errors: 623 chars of output for a page with zero text
Model generated descriptive/metadata content for a blank leather book cover
Should have been classified as blank/cover page with no OCR output
evaluation.notes: Interesting edge case: even Flash hallucinates on blank pages by generating metadata or descriptions. 623 chars is relatively short, so this would not be caught by the 3x-median threshold used in Study 1. This is a different kind of hallucination — not over-generation of text in the source language, but fabrication of structural markup and metadata for a page that has no content. The page should have been classified as 'blank' or 'cover' with null/empty OCR data. This was selected as a 'control' but is actually a minor hallucination case — an interesting discovery.

page_description: Leather book cover/binding. Tan/camel colored leather with decorative tooled border lines. Spine visible on right edge with horizontal bands. Measuring ruler on left edge for scale. No text whatsoever.
